messages:
Iris: Noticed p95 for /v1/generate jumped from 0.2s -> 1.8s around the rollout, while p50 stayed steady. Dashboard's merged line looks suspicious.
Tom: Which rollout? any routing weight changes or quota flips?
Iris: Canary ramp in ap-south: default 80%->50% and slow-node increased 20%->50% between 09:02-09:12. Query used: `percentile(50,95,99)` over 30s step with 3m moving average.
Yvonne: Moving average after merging sketches can create non-monotonic estimates. Also tdigest merge is biased when contributor counts differ by orders of magnitude.
console-team: Confirmed pipeline: per-backend tdigests -> merge -> compute pcts -> smooth. That's the cheap path.
ingest-bot: info: routing-change detected for /v1/generate (2025-03-04T09:05Z)
Tom: Check sample counts. If the slow-node had very few samples with a heavy tail, once its weight increases it can dominate p95 even though p50 unaffected.
Iris: Snapshot: merged_total=1400, merged_p95_count=22, slow-node count=5 with latencies ~2.9s. Histogram shows 4 outliers.
Yvonne: Short-term UX fixes: (1) surface per-backend p95 columns next to merged p95, (2) add a "confidence" pill when any contributor < 30 samples, (3) show routing weight timeline under the chart.
Tom: Alerts: suppress merged-p95 alerts when merged_sample_count < 50 and instead alert on per-backend p95 increases.
console-team: Dev plan: add provenance badge + tooltip: "Merged pcts derived from t-digest merge; low contributor counts can skew tail estimates." We'll also add a one-click "Exact recompute" that pulls raw buckets for the visible window.
Yvonne: Longer term: keep short-lived exact histograms for high-churn endpoints and add a tdigest-merge diagnostic flag that logs contributor centroids when delta>20%.
Iris: I can reproduce locally by simulating a 95/5 split with the slow tail. Will attach a small repro and sample dump to the ticket.
Tom: Good. Also add a runbook note: when p50<=p95 inversion or large p95 jumps with low counts, check per-backend counts and routing changes first.
Iris: Opening issue, tagging @console-team @ingest. Action owners: Iris -> repro + issue, console-team -> badge + exact recompute toggle, Tom -> alert rule change, Yvonne -> diagnostic flag. :white_check_mark:
Tom: Thanks — nice triage.
